text:
Varnholt Logistics appointed Ilse Marrenkamp chief executive in March, replacing interim head Daan Verhoek after a two-month search. The freight group said Marrenkamp joined from NordBay Transport, where she ran European road-haul operations and cut fuel costs by 11% last year. Her appointment came as Varnholt reported 2025 first-quarter revenue of 84.6 million solars, up 6% year on year, with operating margin improving to 9.4% from 8.1%.

Marrenkamp said her first priorities are pricing discipline, depot automation and tighter contract renewals. Analysts said the move signals renewed board focus on execution over expansion. For the logistics sector, it underlines how carriers are prioritising margin repair and network efficiency as volumes stay uneven.
